prompt:

Image 3 is SLOW's model sheet: draw SLOW exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Monochrome Japanese sumi-e ink wash rendering of the same cel anime style: black ink and grey washes on warm washi paper, brush texture, ink bleeds, no color at all, EXCEPT that FAST's windbreaker, if he appears, keeps a faint wash of its orange and teal (he is vivid in SLOW's memory).

Camera: Medium.
Characters: FAST and SLOW only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
No readable text, letters, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles anywhere.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
